entries.note_hr: Put Malog Princa u NP Paklenica zatvoren je do daljnjeg zbog dotrajalih elemenata osiguranja i pomagala u prolasku zahtjevnoga planinarskog puta.
entries.note_en: Put Malog Princa in NP Paklenica is closed until further notice due to worn safety elements and aids on this demanding trail.

entries.note_hr: Privremena nedostupnost planinarskih putova na Dinari u mjesecu lipnju 2026.
entries.note_en: Temporary unavailability of hiking trails on Dinara during June 2026.

entries.note_hr: Mjestimice jaka bura na Velebitskom kanalu. Najjači udari vjetra 35-45 čvorova (65-85 km/h).
entries.note_en: Locally strong bora wind in the Velebit channel area. Peak gusts 35-45 knots (65-85 km/h).
entries.gear: Windproof layer; extra caution on exposed ridgeline sections

entries.note_hr: Lokalno mogući izraženiji pljuskovi praćeni grmljavinom i prolazno jakim vjetrom u Kninskoj regiji. Vjerojatnost grmljavine > 60 %.
entries.note_en: Locally intense showers with thunder and temporarily strong wind possible in the Knin region. Probability of thunderstorms > 60%.
entries.gear: Rain jacket; avoid exposed ridges and high ground during afternoon hours
